Problem Summary:
make sure that all stores support log backup then create log backup tasks.

### What is changed and how it works?
1. add a check before task starts.
2. use tikv status_address to get config and check when log backup is enabled.

issue_context.title: Add a check before starts log backup.
issue_context.body:
basically two things need to be done.
1. make sure that all stores support log backup then create log backup tasks.
2. disable online config for log backup switch. since it cannot be reload automatically.
